about: The AE battle rifle pack: CMT's TSC:E 1.4.1 rifle (art and sounds, credited) made into the approved donor map and the pack. make_pack.py runs it; the locations of the zip, the stock map and the programs are given on its command line.

stock_derived.ae\\packs\\battle_rifle\\hud\\br_meter: the stock ammunition meter sheet (ui\hud\bitmaps\combined\hud_ammo_meters) with the rifle's icon and ticks drawn into it by hud_sheet.py: the rest of the sheet is the game's own pixels
stock_derived.ae\\packs\\battle_rifle\\hud\\br_ammo: the stock assault rifle's weapon HUD interface (its layout numbers) edited by hud_tag.py
stock_derived.ae\\packs\\battle_rifle\\levels\\a10\\bi: a copy of the stock cyborg's mirror cube map, standing in for a campaign cube map one of CMT's glass impact effects names

source.name: CMT's The Silent Cartographer: Evolved 1.4.1c source release

tools.ffmpeg: n9.0.2 (decodes the Ogg Vorbis permutations to 16-bit PCM)
tools.art: Python 3.14 with Pillow 12.2.0 and numpy 2.4.4 drew the art whose SHA-256s are below

steps.why: the donor map: Blood Gulch's scenario without vehicles, the rifle in its weapon palette
the Xbox's model format (Invader's gbxmodel to model)
the Xbox's model format; its parts had no compressed vertices, which the Xbox's build needs
the Xbox model; the pickup and HUD message indices the stock assault rifle's (CMT's point into CMT's own HUD texts)
a stock cube map one of CMT's glass impact effects names, which Blood Gulch does not have: the cyborg's mirror cube map stands in
the swap and pickup prompts' picture of the rifle, in a copy of the stock meter sheet
CMT's interface keeps only its crosshairs; the ammunition panel is the child HUD
the crosshair at 0.42 in CE's colour, red on target; the scope: our sharp lines, the mask without its ring, the ring its own item
the held rifle's collision is the stock assault rifle's
